declaration.declared_before: any Strategy E trading backtest, paper trade, or live trade
declaration.scope: E-D0 artifact integrity only; no signal implementation, execution optimization, or backtest

alpha.statement: premarket_gap > 0 and premarket_rvol >= 3.0 and position_in_premarket_range >= 0.8 and return_0900_0925 > 0

decision.candidate_generation: At 09:25 ET, generate a candidate exactly when the eligible row satisfies frozen E1_H5.

universe.definition: E0 declared PIT universe evaluated at D-1: latest CS reference snapshot as of D-1; XNAS/XNYS/XASE; close(D-1) >= 5 USD; median dollar volume over [D-21,D-2] >= 5,000,000 USD with at least 15 sessions; no split in (D-1,D]. Premarket requires at least 3 bars in [04:00,09:24], at least 50,000 USD premarket dollar volume, and a 09:30 open bar for label/execution availability.

position_count.same_session_candidate_priority: TBD — MUST BE FROZEN BEFORE E-D2 BACKTEST

models.price: open of the 09:30 ET one-minute aggregate bar
models.support: present in the E1 Basic minute dataset
models.limitation: research proxy only; not a guaranteed executable fill and carries no quote, imbalance, auction, spread, or impact information

primary.price: close of the 09:34 ET one-minute aggregate bar
primary.horizon: 09:30 open to completion of the first five regular-session minutes

costs.gross_return: exit proxy / entry proxy - 1 before costs
costs.commission_and_fees: reported separately; UNKNOWN until a frozen schedule is registered
costs.spread_proxy: UNKNOWN; Stocks Basic has no bid/ask quote
costs.slippage_proxy: reported separately; UNKNOWN until a frozen proxy is registered
costs.total_execution_cost: commission_and_fees + spread_proxy + slippage_proxy; stress-grid totals are assumptions, not measurements

risk.sector_concentration: TBD — MUST BE FROZEN BEFORE E-D2 BACKTEST
risk.low_price_liquidity: Research universe floor remains close(D-1) >= 5 USD; any stricter execution eligibility is TBD and must not alter Alpha eligibility.
risk.opening_volatility: TBD — MUST BE FROZEN BEFORE E-D2 BACKTEST
risk.abnormal_session: fail closed unless an explicit behavior is frozen before E-D2

position_sizing.policy: TBD — MUST BE FROZEN BEFORE E-D2 BACKTEST
requirements: compatible with common Risk V1 caps
position_sizing.reason: Risk V1 stop-based 1R sizing requires a structure stop, and Strategy E V1 has no frozen stop contract at E-D0.

integrity.historical_confirmation_repository_role: Generated run payload under data/runtime; not a tracked or canonical repository source. Canonical repository provenance is the frozen declarations, checksums, implementation, tests, report, and commit record.
integrity.historical_confirmation_limitation: The generated trade/event payload cannot be independently replay-audited in this workspace. This does not modify or re-estimate the frozen Alpha Contract.
integrity.serialization: UTF-8 JSON; canonical checksum uses sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false

no_retuning.clause: The H5 Alpha Contract must not change in response to Trading Backtest, Paper Trading, or Forward Validation results.
no_retuning.change_process: Any Alpha change is a separate new research hypothesis and version, not a modification of Strategy E V1.
